# Bycroft LLM Visualization reference

Design and interaction reference: https://bbycroft.net/llm
Source: https://github.com/bbycroft/llm-viz

The Model Atlas viewer is a new Three.js implementation for source-grounded Qwen and MiniMax component graphs. It adopts the tensor-block visual vocabulary, overview-to-operation navigation and guided explanation approach. It does not execute or redistribute Bycroft's GPT inference code, homepage, fonts or model weights. The upstream MIT notice is retained alongside this attribution.
